svg.title: Santa Rosa city outline
svg.desc: North-up outline of Santa Rosa, Laguna derived from the published 2023 PSA and NAMRIA administrative data.
svg.metadata:
City of Santa Rosa, Laguna outline. Derived from committed backend/src/data/santaRosaBoundary.json, the union of 18 barangay polygons from Philippines JSON Maps 2023 high-resolution extract by James Faeldon. Administrative data: Philippine Statistics Authority and NAMRIA. North is up. Equirectangular local projection with longitude scaled by cosine of midpoint latitude (14.27626940 degrees). Indicative administrative boundary, not a cadastral survey.
Barangay navigation locations derived from Philippines JSON Maps (James Faeldon). Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/faeldon/philippines-json-maps/master/2023/geojson/municities/hires/bgysubmuns-municity-403428000.0.1.json Administrative data attribution: Philippine Statistics Authority and NAMRIA. Coordinates and bounding boxes are indicative map navigation aids, not cadastral boundaries or barangay-hall locations.
